testResults.name: [SV1] the inspection finds each named construct in a planted source (negative control)
[SV1] the harness source is the phase-2 tree: no polled runner module, and the scan covers every file
[SV1] holds no polled loop and no tick counter: the only polls are the two AD-17 process entries
[SV1] holds no stale cadence counter: the cadence is a delayed transition of the run supervisor
[SV1] holds no failure map and no runner failure limit: each FAILURE_LIMIT is a guard over a context count
[SV1] holds no stopping flag, children list, worker FiberMap or judged-state list
[SV1] holds no process-wide run registry: no module-level mutable binding or collection keyed by a run
[SV1] a live run that /task started is found through the harness actor system by its run id, and only there
